## Summary

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (format, lint, types, tests, coverage, ZIP and Docker builds).
- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Each coverage metric remains at or above 80%; no exclusions were added to hide missing tests.
- [ ] Updated configuration examples, translations, and documentation when applicable.
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` and the date-based version for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No tokens, `.env` files, private prompts, or provider responses are included.
- [ ] Runtime assets are present in both the source ZIP and Docker image.

## Compatibility / deployment notes

Describe runtime, configuration, privacy, or deployment changes. Write "None" if not applicable.
